answer.reason: Only the slaughter at Shechem's city is a deed of Levi himself; the other verses list his sons or speak of his descendants the Levites.

clauses.english: with Simeon, slew all the males of the city of Hamor and Shechem
clauses.quote: came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males

doubts: EXO 32:26-28, NUM 16, NUM 18:21 and the later verses concern the tribe or sons of Levi, not Levi himself, so they were left out.
GEN 49:5-7 is Jacob's pronouncement on Simeon and Levi, not an event, and was left out.
EXO 6:16 gives only the length of Levi's life, not his death, so no clause was made from it.
EXO 2:1 and NUM 26:59 mention Levi only as an ancestor or as the house of a family.
